// Fixture text, never compiled. An Accessibility polling loop without a pool.
pub fn start_focus_observation(running: Arc<AtomicBool>) {
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        while running.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
            let system = unsafe { AXUIElementCreateSystemWide() };
            let mut value: CFTypeRef = std::ptr::null();
            let status = unsafe {
                AXUIElementCopyAttributeValue(system, kAXFocusedUIElementAttribute, &mut value)
            };
            publish_focus(status, value);
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));
        }
    });
}
